params.caption: 🕹️ Sony releases a new PlayStation Portal with internal storage in Japan A revised PS Portal model arrives in Japan next month, and its main change is built-in storage. Sony points to "future functionality", a hint that the remote-play handheld could gain new features, and the device is also getting a new official name. 🕒 Nov 9, 2026 · 19:23 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: IGN #PlayStation #PSPortal #GamingNews
